literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) derive from a single paper (PMC3824574) and describe one construct: KIR2DL1-tdEosFP. KIR2DL1 is a type I single-pass transmembrane receptor (signal peptide 1–21, extracellular 22–243, TM 244–264, intracellular 265–348). The construct name 'KIR2DL1-tdEosFP' places tdEosFP C-terminally, after residue 348, which is intracellular. The paper confirms surface display of the receptor and tracks membrane dynamics via the cytoplasmic fluorescent tag — a standard approach that does not place any tag on the extracellular face. No ledger line describes an N-terminal, loop-internal, or any other extracellular insertion for KIR2DL1. The mature N-terminus (residue 22, H) is extracellular and in principle accessible, but no ledger line grounds a tag there. Zero extracellular tag sites are supported.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal tdEosFP fusion appended after residue 348 (Pro); the entire C-terminus of KIR2DL1 (residues 265–348) is intracellular, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
